headline.name: RealityLatch
headline.mechanism: Provider/document evidence is mapped with provenance, reconciled against human-approved hard invariants, and admitted into VERIFIED / CONTRADICTED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE before permission state.
headline.verified_now: 19/19 deterministic tests passed in the 2026-08-19 packaging run; preserved three-document Nutrient Studio exports replay into 9 claims and a VERIFIED Case A receipt.
headline.claim_boundary: No production automated Nutrient extraction, shipment action, customer adoption, compliance outcome, scale, savings or revenue claim.

headline.name: DriftGuard / Agent Session Settlement Preflight
headline.mechanism: Seven deterministic settlement gates prevent missing or contradictory runtime evidence from silently becoming a pass.
headline.verified_now: Public claim registry records 52 release checks + 5 judgment tests and a bounded benchmark of 24/24 agreement, 0 critical false passes, and 17 unsupported passes prevented.
headline.claim_boundary: No prevented production incident, production reliability, external adoption or ROI claim.

headline.name: SignalOps Workbench
headline.mechanism: Observed public evidence stays distinct from interpretation, receives deterministic relevance/action state, and is constrained by permission-aware escalation rules.
headline.verified_now: 20 real public LangChain issue surfaces produced 20 durable events: 19 public_reply and 1 save; no private escalation was permitted without a prior public response.
headline.claim_boundary: No ranking-accuracy, maintainer-response, live CRM, meeting, pipeline, revenue or adoption claim.

headline.name: DevTools Signal Engine
headline.mechanism: Real GitHub organization evidence is converted into OBSERVED / INFERRED / UNKNOWN account intelligence with bounded acquisition and explicit sampling scope.
headline.verified_now: Public repo includes a checked-in hiring proof surface and merged Dalus ICP work sample; benchmark/Qatar cohort expansion remains a separate pending merge until finalized.
headline.claim_boundary: GitHub workflow/governance evidence is not buying intent, pain, spend or pipeline.

headline.name: Project Specification Compiler / Target Spec Compiler
headline.proof_level: P2 repo + owner-supplied deployed proof surface
headline.deployment_verification: URL supplied as live proof surface; the packaging browser could not independently fetch this Netlify site.
headline.mechanism: Ambiguous project intent becomes machine-checkable specification structure, status vocabulary, bundle equality and deterministic validation/reporting contracts.
headline.claim_boundary: No organization-level time-savings or reduced-rework claim without repeated before/after use.

headline.name: Reality Handoff Agent
headline.mechanism: DataHub evidence → deterministic gate → explicit execution contract → human approval → one bounded mutation → independent re-read → durable recovery.
headline.verified_now: Repository packaging records 55/55 deterministic/unit/API/frontend-contract tests plus compile/syntax/secret-scan passes.
headline.claim_boundary: Live DataHub P0-P4 is still pending; no live mutation/recovery success is claimed until those receipts exist.

headline.name: TraceCrumb First-60
headline.deployment_verification: Connected Netlify account reports the tracecrumb-f60 deployment ready.
headline.mechanism: Current symptom plus prior incident memory is compressed into a bounded first diagnostic branch and priority checks.
headline.claim_boundary: No production MTTR, first-action improvement, adoption or ROI claim.

headline.name: Ulomis Continuity Companion
headline.deployment_verification: Connected Netlify account reports the ulomis deployment ready.
headline.mechanism: Fragmented evidence becomes source-backed, uncertainty-visible, correctable continuity state for work re-entry and handoff.
headline.claim_boundary: No measured re-entry reduction, repeated use, durable multi-device memory or compounding-learning claim.

supporting.name: Constraint Intelligence Engine
supporting.mechanism: Production-failure evidence is normalized into root constraints, economic chains, separate constraint/intervention value and bounded action routes.
supporting.claim_boundary: Heuristic classification/scoring; no buyer adoption or production outcome claim.

supporting.name: Living Context Engine
supporting.mechanism: Project files become source-linked decisions, blockers, actions, timeline and context packs in SQLite with a read-only API.
supporting.claim_boundary: Not autonomous memory, semantic completeness or production adoption.

supporting.name: Pathmeter
supporting.proof_level: P2 + three normalized public bottleneck cases
supporting.mechanism: Path → limiting stage → intervention → measurable discontinuity is preserved as a reusable bottleneck-analysis structure.
supporting.claim_boundary: The three company cases are first-party published engineering evidence, not Pathmeter customer outcomes.

supporting.name: Operational Waste Recovery / AntiWaste Ops
supporting.deployment_verification: Worker URL supplied as deployed surface; independent fetch was unavailable in the packaging environment.
supporting.mechanism: Imported AI/engineering telemetry is used to detect repeated work and create inspectable reusable context capsules.
supporting.claim_boundary: No realized labor savings, production load, organization-wide waste or ROI claim.

supporting.name: Quickarity
supporting.deployment_verification: Worker URL supplied as deployed surface; independent fetch was unavailable in the packaging environment.
supporting.mechanism: Operator-supplied tasks are deterministically ranked into a bounded three-day plan with blocked/deferred state and portable exports.
supporting.claim_boundary: No claim that score predicts commercial/operational impact or that cold users prefer the capacity model.

supporting.name: IncidentOps / Operational Incident Cognition
supporting.deployment_verification: Worker URL supplied as deployed surface; repo lineage remains older and is not a headline proof family.
supporting.mechanism: Case/timeline/incident cognition lineage for operational incident state and recovery.
supporting.claim_boundary: Do not represent the older repo lineage as a completed production incident platform.
